items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: He cannot play the bass like me or Hennings.

ctx.x: Let me ask you something about your feeling, we got into a thing talking about the writers and everything. And we talked about aspects of the kind of life, the kind of racism that has very much been a part of the society. What about the polls and the whole thing about polls?

Oh yeah, man. I'm glad you asked me that man. I'm glad you asked me that. Now I found out, now I know and you know that some of the guys that won polls shouldn't have. But I also found out that if you've got a few bucks, you can win those polls, man. And I think it's a darn man because I've heard a certain musician that plays the instrument that you and I play winning the polls quite frequently, man. And I know damn well that this man cannot play the bass like some of my friends can play the bass. He cannot play…
